item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.3.3

SupaSidebar 1.3.3 fixes how the sidebar responds to browser windows closing and reopening, and makes the sidebar toggle shortcut more consistent.

Bug Fixes

  • Sidebar Returns When Your Browser Reopens: Fixed the sidebar staying hidden after closing the last browser window and opening a new one, including in Safari. Auto-show continues to respect your settings and manual hide choice.
  • Hide With the Attached Browser: Closing the browser window attached to the sidebar now hides the sidebar instead of keeping it beside another remaining window. This also applies to a manually opened Smart Attach sidebar when automatic browser show is off.
  • Consistent Sidebar Toggle: The toggle shortcut now hides the sidebar on the first press whenever any part of it is visible, even if another app has keyboard focus. If the sidebar is completely covered, the shortcut brings it forward.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
